verdict.rationale: Logseq's default local-first storage is plain Markdown files, and it also ships a dedicated Export feature that dumps the entire graph to open formats (Markdown, JSON, EDN, OPML, HTML, Roam JSON), giving strong lock-in-free portability. Minor caveat noted by community: exported Markdown has slight formatting quirks reducing perfect interoperability with other tools. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of full-fidelity export/import round-trips, and no evidence addressing export completeness for the newer DB-based graph format.
